title: The env-file rule reads bash -c, sh -c and zsh -c command strings
why: On main, a read of an environment file inside a bash -c or sh -c command string gets no refusal. Found by env-child-followups' reviewer; confirmed by the coordinator's probe of hooks/guard.py at 21:22 CST Nov 7.
note: Decision env-file-stays-unread. The coordinator's two probe forms are in its 21:22 CST message; they are not copied here, because a commit that holds them trips the env-file guard. Filed from the coordinator, 21:22 CST Nov 7; filed 21:22 CST.
